mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.2% signals extreme monetary accommodation, compressing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% indicates persistent labor market weakness, suppressing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 9.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Joint monthly increases in housing starts (HOUST) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) above 0.5% signal robust consumer demand for housing, accelerating economic expansion and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both > 0.5% MoM increase
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed 0.5% MoM increases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained three-month decline in FEDFUNDS signals active monetary easing, reducing risk-free rates and increasing equity valuation multiples, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 95.0 indicates contractionary manufacturing activity, reducing corporate output and profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO is below 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: GDP level below 13200 billion dollars (GDPC1) indicates weak economic expansion, reducing consumer confidence and business investment, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 is below 13200.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high unemployment (UNRATE > 9.0%) and rising payrolls (PAYEMS > 0.5% MoM) signal labor market recovery, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 9.0% and PAYEMS shows >0.5% MoM increase.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 218.0 indicates accelerating inflation, triggering expectations of monetary tightening and higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 218.0.
